official.deadline_note: The dedicated SGS notice states the application period ran October 13 to December 10, 2025, while the 2026 postgraduate admission brochures list October 13 to December 12, 2025. For graduate applicants the scholarship is only available in Phase One; Phase Two (March 1-31, 2026) does not accept SGS applications. Undergraduate programmes used separate windows (for example MBBS: January 1-15 and February 23 - March 6, 2026).
official.status_note: The published application window for the 2026 intake closed on December 10, 2025. As of the verification date the ISO website Notices column shows no 2027-cycle Shanghai Government Scholarship announcement; the most recent notices are from February 2026.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Official wording: 'Exemption from tuition fee' (2026 Shanghai Government Scholarship notice). The 2026 postgraduate admission brochure lists scholarship coverage as 'Tuition fee, free university dormitory or accommodation subsidy, free comprehensive medical insurance'.
benefits: Providing free on-campus accommodation or providing accommodation subsidy
Scholarships are used to fund students with excellent academic performance and financial difficulties
eligibility: Applicants should be non-Chinese citizens and in good health

Applicants for master's programs should have obtained a bachelor's degree and be under the age of 35; applicants for doctoral programs should have obtained a master's degree and be under the age of 40
Applicants should not be holding any other scholarship provided by Chinese government
Applicants must meet Fudan University admission requirements and apply through the university's international admissions system indicating Shanghai Government Scholarship
requirements: Application fee of 800 RMB (online payment, non-refundable); the application is considered invalid without paying the fee
Valid ordinary passport with expiry date after March 1, 2027
Doctoral applicants must contact a supervisor first and apply only after the supervisor agrees to accept them, otherwise the application is invalid
Applicants can only apply for one major for the same application period
All uploaded documents must be scanned colour copies (PDF or JPG) of the originals
documents: Completely filled Foreigner Physical Examination Form (filled out in Chinese or English by a hospital, valid for six months); applicants currently residing in China may submit a Residence Permit or Foreign Permanent Resident ID Card instead
Shanghai Government Scholarship application form, downloaded from the ISO website, printed, filled out and signed
Diploma and transcripts of the highest degree conferred (original or notarized copy, with notarized Chinese or English translation if not in Chinese or English)
Two recommendation letters from a professor or associate professor with the referee's hand-written signature
Language certificate and score report (HSK for Chinese-taught programmes; IELTS/TOEFL/Duolingo/PTE for English-taught programmes), issued within 2 years of the exam date
Proof of Non-Criminal Record and Statement of Financial Capacity or Financial Support with the guarantor's bank deposit certificate (minimum 100,000 RMB or equivalent foreign currency)
selection_criteria: Excellent academic performance and financial difficulties (published: 'Scholarships are used to fund students with excellent academic performance and financial difficulties')
Assessment made by the school or department after reviewing the application documents
For undergraduate programmes, awarded by the university based on excellent academic performance and the admission evaluation results
coverage: On-campus accommodation (free) or an accommodation subsidy
Monthly living stipend: 3000 RMB/month for master's students and 3500 RMB/month for doctoral students
application_method: Step One: visit https://iso.fudan.edu.cn/16053/list.htm to download the application form; print, fill out and sign it

Step Two: complete the application at https://istudent.fudan.edu.cn/apply, choosing 'Self-support' as the fund source, then choose the option of 'Shanghai Government Scholarship' and upload the signed scholarship application form
Upload the required documents, including the Foreigner Physical Examination Form, in the online application system
Pay the 800 RMB application fee online; the application is invalid without payment
Check results in the 'Notices' column on the ISO website (https://iso.fudan.edu.cn/isoenglish/)
official.application_route: Apply online through Fudan's international student application system (istudent.fudan.edu.cn/apply): complete the admission application, choose 'Self-support' as fund source and 'Shanghai Government Scholarship' as the scholarship option, upload the separately downloaded signed SGS form plus documents, and pay the 800 RMB application fee.
official.citizenship_residency: Non-Chinese citizens only. Applicants born to Chinese-citizen parents must meet the published nationality qualification rules: either the Chinese-citizen parent held foreign permanent residency before the applicant's birth plus at least 2 years of actual residence abroad between May 1, 2022 and April 30, 2026, or foreign nationality was obtained before May 1, 2022 with formal renunciation of Chinese citizenship plus the same 2-year residence requirement.
official.international_eligibility: Open to international students (non-Chinese citizens) only
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Applied through Fudan University as the awarding institution; no field restriction is stated in the SGS notice, but undergraduate awards are allocated per programme - e.g. the MBBS programme states that two of the most excellent admitted applicants are awarded Shanghai Government Scholarship (Class B) with tuition exemption.
official.research_requirement: The SGS notice itself sets no research requirement. The graduate application Personal Statement should include the expected research proposal alongside study and work experience, academic achievement and career plan (under 1500 Chinese characters or 5000 English characters).
official.description: The Shanghai Government Scholarship for International Students at Fudan University funds non-Chinese citizens with excellent academic performance at master's and doctoral level, exempting tuition and providing free on-campus accommodation or an accommodation subsidy, comprehensive medical insurance and a monthly living stipend. Fudan publishes the scholarship as funding students with excellent academic performance and financial difficulties, awarded after the admission evaluation.
official.program_type: Shanghai Government Scholarship for international students, applied via Fudan University (Class B route)
official.english_requirement: Not stated in the SGS notice itself. Published in Fudan's 2026 admission information: English-taught postgraduate programmes require TOEFL IBT >=90, IELTS Academic >=6.5, Duolingo >=110 or PTE Academic >=61, waived if your first language is English or your previous degree was taught and assessed entirely in English (some programmes require higher, e.g. IELTS 7 overall or above, and some require GRE or GMAT). Chinese-taught postgraduate programmes require HSK Level 5 (score 240 or above) or Level 6 (score 180 or above) for art, humanities and social sciences, and HSK Level 5 (score 210 or above) or Level 6 (score 180 or above) for sciences, engineering and medicine; HSK is exempt if you completed a previous degree taught in Chinese. English and HSK scores must be issued within 2 years of the exam date.

not_confirmed: undergraduate stipend amount - the SGS notice publishes stipends only for master's (3000 RMB/month) and doctoral (3500 RMB/month) students
travel coverage - not mentioned in the official notice
programme duration - set by each programme and not stated in the SGS notice
study mode - not stated in the SGS notice
the 2027-cycle application window - not yet published on the ISO website as of the verification date
verification.notes: Stipend figures, eligibility, coverage and application steps were taken from the SGS notice and its PDF on iso.fudan.edu.cn; deadlines, application fee, documents and language rules were cross-checked against the 2026 English-taught and Chinese-taught admission brochures. The stipend is level-dependent, so funding_amount records the master's figure (3000 RMB/month) with the doctoral figure (3500 RMB/month) published in benefits and coverage.

applicant_utility.summary: This is a university-applied (Class B) Shanghai Government Scholarship: you first submit the admission application at istudent.fudan.edu.cn/apply, choose 'Self-support' as the fund source, then select 'Shanghai Government Scholarship' and upload the separately downloaded, signed SGS form. The award is decided after academic assessment, so transcripts, recommendation letters and the personal statement carry the real weight rather than a separate scholarship essay. Master's winners receive 3000 RMB/month and doctoral winners 3500 RMB/month, plus tuition exemption, free on-campus accommodation or an accommodation subsidy, and comprehensive medical insurance. Budget separately for the 800 RMB non-refundable application fee, airfare and daily spending, because no travel grant is published.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Non-Chinese citizens under 35 (master's) or 40 (doctoral) with strong grades, documentable financial need, and no existing Chinese government scholarship.
application_readiness_checklist: Check passport validity - it must expire after March 1, 2027
Line up two recommenders who are full or associate professors and warn them they have only 15 days after the system link is sent
Book the Foreigner Physical Examination Form within six months of submission, or gather your Residence Permit / Foreign Permanent Resident ID Card if already in China
Prepare the financial guarantor's bank deposit certificate of at least 100,000 RMB or equivalent, original or notarized with translation
Download, print, fill and sign the SGS application form before starting the online application
Doctoral applicants: secure a supervisor's agreement first - the application is invalid without it
Sit the required English or HSK test no more than two years before the deadline
common_rejection_risks: Missing the Phase One window - SGS is accepted only in Phase One (October 13 to December 10, 2025); Phase Two does not accept SGS applications
Choosing the wrong fund source or scholarship option in the system (it must be 'Self-support' plus 'Shanghai Government Scholarship')
Already holding another Chinese government scholarship - an explicit disqualification
Age limits exceeded: over 35 for master's, over 40 for doctoral
Not paying the 800 RMB application fee, which invalidates the whole application
Expecting to add documents after submission - no additional document is accepted once you submit
Applying for a doctoral place without a supervisor who has agreed to accept you
Passport expiring before March 1, 2027, or a physical examination report older than six months
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The 800 RMB non-refundable application fee, international airfare to Shanghai, visa and residence permit costs, textbooks and research or clinical expenses, and daily spending beyond the monthly stipend. For reference, published tuition without the scholarship is 26000-54000 RMB/year for Chinese-taught postgraduate programmes, 50000-269900 RMB/year for English-taught postgraduate programmes, 23000-42000 RMB/year for Chinese-taught undergraduate programmes, and 75000 RMB/year for MBBS.
document_audit: All uploads must be colour scans in PDF or JPG of the original documents; merge same-type files into one file in chronological order
Recommendation letters need the referee's hand-written signature - electronic signatures are not accepted
The Foreigner Physical Examination Form must be completed by a hospital in Chinese or English and stays valid for only six months
Diplomas and transcripts must be originals or notarized copies with notarized Chinese or English translations when not already in Chinese or English
The ID photo must be a recent bareheaded, full-faced colour photo on a white or blue background - selfies, black-and-white and artistic photos are rejected
The financial guarantor must be over 18 with a stable income, and the bank certificate must show at least 100,000 RMB or equivalent in original or notarized form
alerts: The 2026 round closed on December 10, 2025 and no 2027-cycle notice was posted as of October 10, 2026 - the ISO Notices column is the only official channel, so check it from early October onward
Scholarship students must register on the date in the admission notice; arriving late without prior approval cancels the award automatically
The award is subject to annual evaluation and failure to meet requirements cancels it; once awarded you cannot change major or study period
Graduate applicants who wait for Phase Two (March) forfeit any SGS chance for that intake
Undergraduate SGS is not a blanket award - programme pages such as MBBS state that only the most excellent admitted applicants (two for MBBS) receive SGS Class B
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Complete the online admission application with 'Self-support' fund source, pay the 800 RMB fee, upload the signed SGS form and all supporting documents; the school or department assesses the file, admission and scholarship results are released through the application system and the ISO Notices column.
